privacy: All raw staging captures, contact sheets, traces and recordings remain private in ignored .work. This receipt contains metadata, hashes and technical dispositions only; no credentials or professional body copy.

accessibilityReview.disposition: Incomplete color-contrast observations were inspected for computed color/background (all observed ratios meet4.5:1); decorative arrows are aria-hidden within named actions. Open-dialog aria-hidden-focus observations refer to inert outside content and Radix guards; all240 actual Tab/Shift+Tab samples stayed inside the dialog with visible unobscured focus. Automated results and these keyboard/zoom observations do not substitute for the pending formal screen-reader inspection.

nativeZoom.protocol: Default page zoom via Chrome settingsPrivate on the browser-owned settings page of an isolated profile, headless full Chrome; observed CSS viewport and DPR. No CSS zoom or pinch emulation.

coverage.newArticlePairBehavior: Live staging cases contain no article/pair images. The changed intrinsic-ratio behavior is proven by12 delayed-image scenarios using actual CaseImage SSR/CSS and by real Native depth1 integration assertions in the local/Linux full gate. The isolated18-frame original-content fixture proves original composition but has no new article/pair blocks.
coverage.layoutRegression: All30 complete current candidate screenshots have identical RGB pixels, dimensions and media geometry to independently verified36f predecessor captures. No masks, thresholds, resizing or changed-pixel exclusions were applied.
coverage.originalComposition: The current-source isolated original-content fixture covers all18 approved frames through actual production DTO mappers and page/layout components. Exact authored PT footer/challenge/process lines were recovered from archived official JSX; unavailable Home/About/EN hard breaks remain an explicit fixture projection limit.

limits: No Figma pixel-identity claim; observed approved product differences and staging editorial differences are dispositioned per frame.
Original-content fixture is isolated SSR presentation and does not prove runtime hydration, Native editing or authorization; full integration/browser gates are separate evidence.
Formal screen-reader inspection remains pending by user direction.
No editorial CMS writes, content publication or browser requests beyond GET/HEAD were performed.
